snippet.title: Star Spark Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Star Spark on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639950/Star_Spark/

This is the original announcement trailer for Star Spark (was previously hidden),
--
Fighters from across the universe have gathered to prove themselves in the Star Spark Tournament, a fierce competition that tests their endurance just as much as their fighting ability. You'll have to survive danger-filled planets, master combos, learn new skills, and outwit your enemies if you want to make it to the top!

Star Spark combines real-time combo inputs, turn-based combat, deckbuilding strategy, and roguelite elements to deliver an experience inspired by anime tournament arcs.

#GameDev #IndieGame #TurnBased #Roguelite #Godot #StarSpark
